t: A small, friendly school robot packed with sensors and lights.
steps: Buy a Thymio II Wireless from a store such as RobotShop or Funduino.
Charge the battery with the micro-USB cable.
Turn it on and press the arrow buttons to try the six built-in behaviors.
Download the free Thymio Suite app from the Thymio website.
Plug the wireless dongle into your computer and open Thymio Suite.
Choose VPL and try the obstacle dodging example.
Move on to Scratch, Blockly, or Aseba text code for bigger projects.
meta: Open Board. From $186. A few stores.
